name: Koncolos
source:
At the place where Aras works, a woman makes a scene every night. Aras feels an oddness in what little information he has managed to find out and realizes that every clue points to a single fact. Monsters are real, and they live among us. Aras learns that in all those spooky stories that he has been listening to since his childhood, these creatures who have troubled people continue in their way.

[from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1912490/Koncolos/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在阿拉斯工作的地方，每晚都有一名女子前来闹事。他从好不容易打听到的零星消息中察觉到了异样，并发现所有线索都指向同一个事实：怪物确实存在，而且就生活在我们身边。阿拉斯这才明白，童年时听过的那些恐怖故事里、曾给人们带来灾祸的生物，如今依然在继续作祟。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1912490/Koncolos/]Steam[/url]]
